title: Classifier token-id fixture
description: Token ids and marker positions produced by a model's own Python input builder, which sidekick's Rust port must reproduce exactly. Generated by the conversion tools; read by sidekick-embed's tests. See docs/design/classify.md.

tokenizer_sha256.description: sha256 of the tokenizer.json the ids were produced with

decide.description: fev: the <decide> position, where the pointer head's query is read

seg.description: agentjev: each token's tree segment (0 the prefix, c candidate c)

position_ids.description: agentjev: each token's position; every candidate's restart at the prefix's end
